name: 500 Rum
summary: A rummy variant where players meld sets and runs and must manage discard pile takes to be first to 500 points.
rules_text: Use a standard 52-card deck. Ace can be high or low, but runs cannot wrap K-A-2. Deal 7 cards each, 13 if 2 players. Stock face down, top card face up starts discard pile, spread to see all cards. On your turn you may draw top of stock, or take any card from discard pile plus all cards above it; the selected discard must immediately be melded or laid off, other taken cards may be kept. Before discarding, you may lay matched sets of 3-4 of a kind, or sequences of 3+ same-suit cards, in front of you, and lay off cards onto any table melds. When one player empties hand, hand ends. Each player scores face value of cards melded minus value of cards left in hand; difference adds to cumulative score. First to +500 total wins; if tie, higher total wins.
rating_reason: Rummy meld game, hidden hands, sequential draw and meld, arithmetic race
